title: HydroPulse v2.2.3 - Clean Startup Architecture & Release Keystore Alignment
changelog: Fixed Blank Screen on Launch: Eliminated unhandled KeyStore async deadlock in router initialization, adding safe fallback and instant UI rendering.
Persistent Release Keystore: Configured persistent upload signing keystore to eliminate package conflict installation errors on Android devices.
Verified Live Hardware MQTT Ping/Pong: Backend actively tests physical hardware connectivity over HiveMQ before reporting status, completely eliminating mock states.
Sub-300ms Actuation Round-Trip: Microsecond GPIO relay actuation directly in Core 0 mqttCallback with plaintext START_OK/STOP_OK.
Strict 1.5-Second Heartbeat SLA: 500ms dedicated heartbeats feed a strict 1500ms watchdog with immediate MQTT LWT availability trigger.
